name: Berserker · Knight style B (Raider)
description: Ulfric as a Norse raider in the plumed Knight’s style: bare-headed, with long red hair that streams back off his crown and a thin braid with an iron bead, a braided red beard down his chest, and a band of blue-grey war paint across his eyes and round his bare, muscled upper arms. A heavy fur cape and a fur mantle over the shoulders, a brown leather jerkin with an iron band and an iron belt, fur-wrapped boots, a savage forward lean, and a bearded axe in each fist (one raised forward, one trailing behind). As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark shade of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted, cool purple in the shadows and warm in the light; the red hair and paint are the one accent. His hair, braid and cape sway in a heavy breathing idle and stream back on the walk. The attack is a two-axe overhead chop: he rears back with both axes up, swings them over the top, crashes them down in front on the release frame with a wide white crescent, bites the ground in a spray of chips and recovers.
